clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Darkshore, Prospector Remtravel leads an Explorers' League dig among ancient relics. The dwarf's scattered focus and the dangers around camp make his work perilous.

The Explorers' League sent Prospector Remtravel across the sea to establish a dig in southern Darkshore. Night elves guard their ancestral lands, yet the League's drive to uncover Azeroth's origins carries its prospectors into forgotten places. Remtravel unearths fossilized history and ancient stones, while aggressive wildlife and hostile local threats make the camp difficult for one scatterbrained dwarf to manage.
